text:
Nina: quick follow-up from the chaos run: some EU tenants briefly landed in us-west during a prewarm exhaustion. we need a clear handshake to avoid residency leakage.
Omar: saw that. looks like revoke acks were delayed and controller retried fallback immediately.
Priya: suggestion: emit a short transfer token on lease relinquish so the old holder can accept straggling requests for a bounded window. token must honor residency policy.
Ben: token approach is light-weight. token fields: id, expires_ms, allowed_regions. proxies validate token. default TTL=250ms.
Nina: semantics: ACTIVE -> TRANSFERRING(token) -> TRANSFERRED. while TRANSFERRING old holder can still accept tokened requests.
Priya: policy enforcement: if tenant.residency==STRICT then token.allowed_regions must be subset of resident regions; no cross-region tokens.
Omar: probe order change: local_pool -> reserved_pools -> regional_warm_nodes -> cross_region. controller should probe reserved pools before fallback.
Nina: timings: fast probe 1s, total interactive window 5s. batch jobs can be longer.
ops-bot: metrics to add: lease.transfer.started, lease.transfer.token_emitted, lease.transfer.token_accept, lease.transfer.token_reject{reason}. dashboards created.
Priya: RFC action: I'll draft minirfc with state machine, config knobs (`transfer_token_ttl_ms`, `probe_window_ms`, `token_policy`) and sample config.
Ben: tests: unit TTL + policy, e2e chaos with delayed revoke acks verifying no cross-region accept for STRICT tenants.
Nina: ops playbook: if token_reject(reason=residency) > 0 for >2 tenants in 10m -> page legal+infra, do not auto-failover. emergency override requires legal approval.
Omar: agreed. tagging @Priya and @Ben to own RFC and tests. follow-up 30m tomorrow.
